title: Fun
text: Fun. This is a wonderful set of Bridal party games. The cards are double sided with games on each side so there are plenty of fun questions to answer. The printing is very clear on the cards And there is plenty of Writing space to put your answers. The fun game has questions like Who's the better driver driver?,..Now that's sure to start an interesting conversation LOL. Another one is...Who has more shoes?.lol I would Recommend This game for everyone

product_metadata.title: Queelife Bridal Shower Games Set Of 4 Games For 40 Guests Double Sided Cards Bridal Shower Game Set Bridal Shower Decoration Favors Party Supplies Wedding Shower Games
features: Double Sided Print： 80 cards - 40 cards per game! Two games per card, better value package.

Fun Bridal Games: 4 games - 40x Him Or Her, 40x Who Knows The Bride Best, 40x Who Knows The Groom Best, and 40x Word Scramble. The perfect game pack for your guests, entertain your guests with 4 games to bring joy.

Stylish Design: Bridal Shower Games are specially designed in green watercolor, a unique selection of modern fonts to complement the elegant floral design. Vibrant colors to help start your wedding shower in a fun, laughable way.

Premium Card: The bridal shower games are printed on thick paper, using heavyweight 137g glossy cardstock, these games are engaging and fun for the whole tribe of brides, with a different game printed on each side.
Perfect Size: Measuring 8.26x5.43inch, the game card is easy to include in wedding venue setups and easy to send to guests for fun wedding games together.
